first_setup.title: Set Up BRUH Claude
first_setup.description:
This creates:
- A **conversation agent** that appears in Settings > Voice Assistants
- **Usage limit sensors** that track your Anthropic account usage

You can add more agents with different personalities later using the **Add Service** button.

data_description.name: This name appears in Voice Assistants and on the Devices page.

add_agent.title: Add Another Agent
add_agent.description:
Create a new conversation agent with its own personality. Each agent gets its own model, system prompt, and timeout.

**Usage sensors are shared** — they're account-wide and already set up.

data_description.name: A unique name for this agent (e.g. 'Sarcastic Claude', 'Kitchen Assistant').
data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: Defines who this agent is: identity, tone, and verbosity. It takes precedence over the built-in style — device control, tools, and the area map are appended automatically and stay out of its way. Include a length rule (e.g. keep spoken replies short) if your persona tends to ramble.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

hassio_confirm.title: BRUH Claude Discovered
hassio_confirm.description:
The BRUH Claude Terminal add-on has been detected. Click Submit to create a conversation agent and usage limit sensors.

You can add more agents with different personalities later from the integration page.

menu_options.add_agent: Conversation agent — a voice personality for Assist
menu_options.add_insight: Insight job — a scheduled Claude report on a sensor

add_insight.title: Add Insight Job
add_insight.description:
Claude runs this job on a schedule and writes a markdown report to a sensor.

Getting started: pick a template and a schedule — that's enough. After creating it, the job runs once within ~2 minutes; you'll get a notification with a dashboard card ready to paste (also available any time as the sensor's card_yaml attribute). Run it any time with the job's Run now button.

To read or customize the template's full prompt, open Configure on the created entry — it shows the exact text that runs.

data_description.insight_prompt: Leave empty to use the template. Anything here overrides it. Supports Home Assistant templating — states(...), state_attr(...) — rendered before each run.
data_description.interval_minutes: 0 disables interval runs (daily time or Run now button only).
data_description.daily_at: 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 07:30. Works alone or together with the interval.
data_description.model: Haiku is fastest, Opus is most thorough. Default uses the terminal's model.
data_description.notify_service: Push every successful report to this notify service, e.g. mobile_app_bens_iphone. Empty disables.

error.addon_not_running: The BRUH Claude Terminal add-on does not appear to be running. Start the add-on and try again.
error.no_features: Please enable at least one feature.
error.invalid_daily_at: Daily time must be HH:MM (24-hour), e.g. 07:30.

abort.already_configured: BRUH Claude is already configured. You can add more conversation agents from the integration page using 'Add Service'.
